baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated guidance verbs frame the person who follows God's approval.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine leading supplies a direction, while following supplies sustained tracking and approval supplies the criterion. Guidance therefore works as a response-conditioned movement rather than as information deposited in a passive recipient.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a road supplies the divine lead that frames the sequence.
Following behind makes the recipient an active tracker of that lead.
Abundant or sought approval names the orientation being tracked.
Acceptance rather than displeasure gives the orientation its evaluative polarity.

changed_reading.before: God gives a person directions toward a good destination.
changed_reading.after: God's gentle lead becomes an itinerary through the person's continued tracking of what God accepts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Plural paths of peace precede a singular straight path.
baseline_models.mechanism: Several traversable routes can carry intactness and reconciliation, yet they converge on one balanced course that holds life and action upright. The plurality is functional variety, not incoherence.

activation_trace.role: An extended traversable road gives each plural path concrete continuity.
Freedom from damage makes safety an achieved condition of the routes.
Reconciliation opposite warfare gives the routes a social function.
The singular road supplies the convergent course.
Balance and straightness define the course's alignment.
A sustaining support makes straightness something that keeps a life standing.

changed_reading.before: Peace is reached by one correct road.
changed_reading.after: Multiple practices of safety and reconciliation can converge into one stable, life-sustaining alignment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: God brings them from plural darknesses into singular light by His permission.
baseline_models.mechanism: The transfer is both relocation and disclosure: layered misplacements and obstructions are left for a visible, navigable condition. Permission marks the transition as a deliberate authorization rather than an automatic optical event.

activation_trace.role: Passage to the outside supplies the spatial transfer.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the disclosure dimension.
Material misplacement makes one darkness a state in which things no longer occupy their due positions.
Withholding and confinement add obstruction to the darknesses.
Illumination gives the destination ordinary visibility.
A conspicuous road mark makes the light navigable rather than merely bright.
Authorization governs the transfer.

changed_reading.after: God authorizes a transfer out of layered obstruction and dislocation into disclosed, navigable order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same guidance root appears as a marked offering physically led toward sanctuary among people deliberately aiming at the Sacred House and seeking approval. This materializes guidance as protected, purposive convoy movement, not only cognitive direction.

activation_trace.role: Gentle road-leading anchors the changed model in the focus verbs.
A consecrated offering led to sanctuary gives guidance an embodied transport image.
A neck marker makes the convoy's protected purpose publicly legible.
Deliberate aiming supplies the travelers' directed agency.
A dwelling or refuge gives the movement a receiving center.
Protected spatial boundaries surround the destination and its approach.
Sought approval explicitly matches the focus movement's criterion.

structural_cues: 5:2 places the offering, its collars, sanctuary-bound travelers, the Sacred House, and sought approval inside one movement sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a ritual convoy and exact guidance/approval root echoes; I let that convoy color the focus as embodied protected movement. A live alternative keeps the sacrificial noun and the guidance verbs semantically separate.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an inward grasp of directions.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be experienced as a marked, protected approach in which a follower is steadily conducted toward sacred refuge and approval.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water washing and clean-earth wiping are condition-sensitive routes to the same purified state. Their substitution, coupled with the stated rejection of constriction, makes the plural paths routes adapted to circumstance while still converging on one completed alignment.

activation_trace.role: Plural traversable routes anchor the availability of more than one valid procedure.
Leaving one state for another anchors purification as an enacted transition.
Flowing water removes adhering dirt and supplies the default material route.
Passing the hand and removing a trace supplies a lighter embodied operation.
Removal of impurity names the shared end state.
Water identifies the ordinary medium whose absence activates an alternative.
The clean-earth procedure supplies the alternate route under constrained conditions.
The face of the earth supplies the substitute material.
The denial of constriction prevents one route from becoming an impassable bottleneck.
Completion makes the alternate routes converge on a fulfilled purpose.

structural_cues: 5:6 alternates water and clean earth according to illness, travel, and availability, then states that the purpose is purification and completion rather than hardship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two embodied procedures, conditional substitution, and one stated purpose; I map that topology onto plural paths converging on one straight course. The alternative is that the purification rule merely exemplifies flexibility without defining the focus metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The plural paths are several abstract teachings.
changed_reading.after: They can be circumstance-sensitive procedures that move different bodies through different media toward the same purified and completed orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The route is repeatedly bound to covenants that must be fulfilled, heard, obeyed, and not unraveled. In that setting, guidance by permission becomes a communicative and relational circuit: an authorized summons is received and enacted, and route failure appears as covenant breach.

activation_trace.role: Listening and accepting what is heard opens permission toward reception.
Authorization keeps that reception under divine command.
Completion without deficiency makes covenant performance whole.
A binding obligation gives the route durable relational form.
A confirmed covenant supplies the setting for hearing and obedience.
Hearing as understanding and compliance turns reception into action.
Willing obedience completes the response side of guidance.
The explicit path from which one can stray ties covenant performance back to the focus route.
Unraveling what was made firm supplies the route's failure mechanism.

structural_cues: 5:1 opens with fulfilling binding obligations; 5:7 couples a covenant with hearing and obedience; 5:12 ends a list of covenant acts with straying from the path; 5:13 begins with breach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated covenant mechanics, receptive obedience, explicit path loss, and breach; I infer that these are operating conditions of the focus guidance. A live alternative treats them as adjacent duties rather than as the mechanism of permission.

changed_reading.before: By His permission means that God allows the transfer.
changed_reading.after: Divine permission also functions as an authorized address that must be heard, accepted, performed, and kept intact over time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hostility is treated as an input that must not be allowed to cross into aggression or crooked judgment. Cooperation in expansive good, sustained equitable witness, pardon, and graceful turning-away are active routing operations; forgetting a covenantal share instead feeds enmity and hatred.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation opposite warfare anchors peace as conflict work.
Sustained care and upkeep make straightness an ongoing practice.
Hatred supplies the hostile pressure entering the routing mechanism.
Crossing a limit into wrongdoing names the prohibited output.
Mutual assistance supplies a collective routing operation whose object can be chosen.
Expansive good gives cooperation its peace-producing direction.
The upholding occurrence, grouped with the people occurrence, echoes the focus straightness root as maintained justice.
A straight balance supplies the measuring instrument of social straightness.
Justice in judgment and conduct is the demanded correction under hatred.
Leaving punishment and effacing offense interrupts retaliation.
Graceful turning-away supplies a second de-escalation operation.
Enmity is the relational state produced when the peace-routing mechanism fails.
Affective aversion shows the failure propagating into inner disposition.

structural_cues: 5:2 and 5:8 repeat the pattern hatred must not cause transgression or injustice; 5:13 supplies pardon and graceful turning-away; 5:14 contrasts forgotten covenantal material producing enmity and hatred.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile pressure, forbidden escalation, corrective practices, and a contrasting failure outcome; I infer a causal routing system in which peace is produced by disciplined responses. The alternative is to read these as separate virtues without making them the paths of peace.

changed_reading.before: The paths of peace lead away from already-ended conflict.
changed_reading.after: The paths of peace are repeatable controls that transform live hostility before it crosses into aggression, crooked judgment, or durable enmity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Darkness becomes a distributed textual disorder: wording is deflected from its placement, portions are neglected, and material is concealed. The arriving light and written message restore legibility by clarifying much, while overlooking much makes the disclosure selective rather than indiscriminate.

activation_trace.role: Bringing hidden material out anchors disclosure in the focus extraction.
Misplacement supplies a concrete form of textual darkness.
Conspicuous marking makes restored disclosure navigable.
Deflection from a direction supplies the displacement operation.
Placement in a due location supplies the order being disturbed.
Neglect and abandonment remove a portion from operative memory.
Concealment supplies the covered material to be disclosed.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies the disclosure operation.
Effacing an effect supplies deliberate non-exposure alongside clarification.
Ordered letters and the written object provide the medium whose legibility is restored.
The explicit contextual light confirms illumination as disclosure.

structural_cues: 5:13 sequences displaced wording and a forgotten portion; 5:15 answers with an envoy who clarifies much concealed material, overlooks much, and arrives with light and a clear written message.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies textual dislocation, concealment, clarification, selective overlooking, and explicit light; I infer that these form a repair process behind the focus transfer. A live alternative keeps darkness and light general while treating textual repair as only one instance.

changed_reading.before: The darknesses are generic ignorance and the light is total exposure.
changed_reading.after: The darknesses include accumulated dislocation, neglect, and concealment, while the light selectively restores enough legibility to make a route visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: A claim of filial and beloved status is tested against punishment, wrongdoing, creaturehood, and forgiveness. This sharpens the focus relative clause: access to guidance is characterized by enacted following of approval, not by inherited or asserted intimacy.

activation_trace.role: Active following supplies the focus criterion.
Acceptance supplies the relation that must be pursued rather than presumed.
Lineage and attributed origin supply the asserted inherited status.
Heart-attached love supplies the claimed privileged relation.
Punitive pain tests whether the claimed status exempts conduct from consequence.
Wrongdoing supplies the conduct for which identity does not substitute.
Created existence resets the claimants inside a shared creaturely category.
Protective covering of wrongdoing keeps mercy available without making it hereditary.

structural_cues: 5:18 places the claim of being children and beloved immediately against accountability for wrongdoing, common creaturehood, forgiveness, and punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a status claim and its conduct-based rebuttal; I infer that the focus's 'who follows' is deliberately open and performative. The alternative is that 5:18 rebuts only an excessive claim without defining eligibility in 5:16.

changed_reading.before: Guidance follows from belonging to a favored religious identity.
changed_reading.after: The guided class is constituted through following what God accepts; lineage and a claim to belovedness cannot replace that movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: A messenger arrives and clarifies after slackness in the relay, carrying both opening news and warning. The focus's spatial guidance can therefore also be read temporally as transmission restarting after an interval in which directional signals had weakened.

activation_trace.role: A leading vanguard gives guidance the form of an arriving advance signal.
A visible route marker supplies the restored signal.
Repeated arrival restarts contact.
Messenger and message define the relay being resumed.
Clarification turns renewed contact into usable direction.
Slackness after intensity supplies the temporal gap.
Joy-opening news supplies one polarity of the renewed signal.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the other polarity.

structural_cues: 5:19 repeats arrival around a stated interval between messengers and pairs renewed clarification with good news and warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a slack interval, renewed arrival, clarification, and a two-pole message; I infer a temporal signal-restoration model for guidance. A live alternative preserves the focus as purely spatial and treats the interval only as historical timing.

changed_reading.before: Guidance points along a continuously available spatial route.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can also be the restoration of directional transmission after a period of weakened relay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence opposes commanded entry to backward reversal, waiting for opponents to exit, refusal to enter, permanent sitting, and eventual wandering. It turns guidance into threshold action: divine extraction does not mean waiting passively for every external obstruction to remove itself.

activation_trace.role: Road-leading anchors the closing movement sequence in the focus.
Exit from an enclosing state supplies the focus's liberation movement.
Entry into an interior makes guidance a threshold-crossing command.
Returning backward supplies the prohibited reversal.
Turning one's back gives reversal bodily orientation.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the resulting inversion.
Repeated entry language makes crossing the disputed action.
The demand that opponents first exit externalizes the condition the refusers impose on action.
The answering counsel repeats entry as the decisive movement.
A concrete entrance localizes the decisive threshold.
Reliance joins rather than replaces threshold action.
Permanent refusal negates the required movement.
Duration and stillness harden a temporary obstacle into an indefinite excuse.
Sitting out the action supplies the opposite of following.

structural_cues: 5:21 commands entry and prohibits backward turning; 5:22 conditions entry on others' prior exit; 5:23 redirects action through the gate with reliance; 5:24 fixes refusal as permanent sitting; branchless ت ي ه at 5:26 marks the resulting wandering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated entry/exit reversal, a gate, reliance joined to action, immobilized refusal, and later wandering; I infer that the focus extraction requires responsive threshold crossing rather than passive obstacle removal. The alternative is that the closing narrative illustrates disobedience generally without specifying the mechanics of guidance.

changed_reading.before: Being brought from darkness to light is a passive relocation performed on recipients.
changed_reading.after: Divine extraction opens a threshold that followers must enter; demanding that the obstacle leave first converts a straight route into reversal, stasis, and wandering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the sacrificial noun's material image onto verbal guidance. It remains anchored by the exact guidance root at 5:16 and 5:2, the collared sanctuary-bound offering, deliberate aiming, and sought approval. Downstream prose should call it a ritual analogy, not claim that the focus verbs grammatically mean sacrificial offering.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two guidance verbs can carry an exploratory echo of something gently delivered toward sacred custody.

activation_trace.role: The offering-to-sanctuary branch supplies the exploratory transfer image inside the focus root.
The contextual offering makes that branch materially present rather than merely available in inventory.
A visible neck marker identifies consecrated custody during transport.
Deliberate aiming keeps the analogy directional.
Refuge supplies the receiving destination.
Sought approval connects consecrated movement to the focus criterion.

changed_reading.before: God instructs and escorts a follower.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the follower is also imaged as something gently delivered into sacred refuge, so guidance resembles consecrated transfer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the swallowing branch of the path root through the packet's dense intake rules. It remains anchored in the focus path word and the 5:1-5 sequence of released prohibitions, forbidden intake, eating, holding, and shared food. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for disciplined permeability, not as the ordinary lexical sense of the straight path.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The straight path's branch inventory includes passage by swallowing.

activation_trace.role: Disappearance through passage and swallowing supplies the regulated-intake image.
Release of a prohibition opens selected material to passage.
Prohibition closes other material against intake.
Taking food in makes bodily passage explicit.
Holding material back supplies a gate before intake.
Tasting and taking food extends regulated passage across communities.

changed_reading.before: The straight path is an external route traveled by a person.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is disciplined permeability: a rule-governed passage determining what may be taken in, what must be held back, and how incorporation remains safe.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the form-distant non-dominant ه د د target attached to the focus guidance root. It remains anchored by the repeated guidance forms, the focus extraction from obstructive darkness, and the later gate/stasis contrast. Downstream prose must label it a split-root resonance rather than translating guidance as demolition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-dominant mapped inventory lets repeated guidance resonate with breaking an enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition provide the deliberately form-distant resonance.
Exit from an enclosing state attaches the resonance to an actual focus movement.
Confinement and withholding make the darkness an obstruction capable of being broken.
A gate materializes the enclosing threshold.
Sitting out action shows the immobilization the breaking image would oppose.

changed_reading.before: Guidance gently indicates an available road.
changed_reading.after: At the split-root edge, guidance also resonates as breaking the enclosure that keeps a person blocked from exit and entry.

strongest_changes: Plural paths became circumstance-sensitive procedures and conflict-regulating practices that converge on one maintained alignment.
Darkness-to-light became selective repair of displaced, forgotten, and concealed material rather than generic illumination.
Permission became covenantal reception through hearing, obedience, performance, and non-breach.
The closing entry/refusal sequence turned guidance into threshold action opposed to reversal, stasis, and wandering.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly materialized the focus's abstract movement as ritual convoy, bodily purification, covenant maintenance, equitable conflict handling, textual disclosure, restored message relay, and gate crossing without forcing those mechanisms into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: How strongly the sanctuary-offering sense should color the verbal guidance forms rather than remain a contextual analogy.
Whether the hearing branch of permission is a durable semantic layer or only activated by the nearby hearing-obedience covenant.
Whether selective overlooking is part of the light's mechanism or simply accompanies disclosure.
Whether the swallowing and demolition outliers remain useful after their branch distance is made explicit.
